task_spec: The first component of a URL is the 'scheme' (e.g. http, https), not the 'schema'. User-facing error messages and exception docstrings must call it the scheme. (psf/requests#5984)

bugs.description: The user-facing error message says 'No schema supplied' but the correct term for a URL's http/https prefix is 'scheme', not 'schema'. This confuses users (schema errors mean something else) and the linked issue #5984 asks for the wording to be corrected. Locally the string is not a code defect; only the convention/issue makes 'schema' wrong.
bugs.seed_note: NATURAL bug: inverse of the real fix in psf/requests PR #6017 (closes #5984).
